page_title: FIO 0-2 COM | Fiorentina v Como 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van der Brempt I. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fiorentina comes to nothing.
90+5' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Now Fiorentina have a corner.
90+4' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina will have a throw-in.
90+1' Substitution. Fellipe Jack (Como) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Assane Diao walks off.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
88' Shots on target – 3:4.
85' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jean Butez, who smothers the ball.
85' Fiorentina take a short corner kick.

85' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. It will be a corner kick for Fiorentina.
83' Ivan Smolcic (Como) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
83' Ivan Smolcic (Como) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

81' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Jean Butez displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
78' Substitution. Jonathan Ikone (Como) has come on for Nico Paz.
78' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Maxence Caqueret will be replaced by Yannik Engelhardt (Como).

76' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) for Albert Gudmundsson.

73' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Edoardo Goldaniga (Como), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
73' Corner kick. Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is ready to send the ball into the box.

73' Assane Diao (Como) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but David de Gea thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Como.
70' The referee signals a substitution. Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Rolando Mandragora.
70' It will be a substitution. Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is ready to enter the pitch as Robin Gosens walks off.
70' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Maximo Perrone (Como) is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas.
69' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) replacing Alberto Dossena.
68' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
66' 0 - 2 Nico Paz (Como) receives a precise pass just outside the box and produces a glorious strike into the left side of the goal off the post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
64' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) for his blatant foul.
63' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
61' The linesman raises his flag. Assane Diao (Como) is adjudged offside.
60' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
59' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
58' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
57' Maximo Perrone (Como) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
55' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) replaces Danilo Cataldi.
55' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) will replace Nicolo Zaniolo.
53' It must be a yellow card. It is. Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
52' The game has begun to heat up. Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
48' The foul by Assane Diao (Como) was seen by Marco Piccinini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
46' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Marco Piccinini has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle after Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

41' 0 - 1 What a GOAL! A quick turnover allows Assane Diao (Como) to mount a one-man counter attack and ends with him scoring with a precise shot from close in that easily beats the keeper. That makes it 0:1.
40' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' The total number of attempts is 3:3.
36' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina).
36' Como are ruled offside.
35' A lofted cross from Maxence Caqueret (Como) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
34' Dodo (Fiorentina) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

30' Maximo Perrone (Como) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
29' Alex Valle (Como) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. It's a throw-in for Como.
28' Nico Paz (Como) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
27' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Piccinini had an easy-decision to make.
26' The percentage of ball possession is – 43:57.
24' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
23' Assane Diao (Como) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Piccinini has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
22' One of the players from Como times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

21' David de Gea pulls off a great save to deny Assane Diao (Como) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
19' Alex Valle (Como) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
18' Nico Paz (Como) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
16' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Fiorentina was in an offside position.

15' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Jean Butez is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
15' Fiorentina seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
11' The ball is cleared after Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
11' The referee blows his whistle as Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in his challenge.
10' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
8' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
7' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marco Piccinini saw the whole situation.
7' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.

5' A neat pass is well received by Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
5' Nico Paz (Como) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' Marco Piccinini interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Edoardo Goldaniga (Como).

3' Assane Diao (Como) comes close to scoring. He peels away from his marker and gets on the end of a cross from Lucas Da Cunha, but he hits a shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
1' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
